step_description: Identified bacterial strains via sequencing and analysis of 16S rRNA genes
Demultiplexed, quality-controlled, and adapter-trimmed Illumina paired-end sequencing reads
Assembled paired-end Illumina reads into draft genomes using the BV-BRC genome assembly pipeline (Unicycler)
Assessed genome completeness and contamination using CheckM
Annotated the draft genomes using the NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline
Performed digital DNA-DNA hybridization analysis via TYGS for species identification
Calculated average nucleotide identity to compare genomes and assess species relatedness
